trend_following_breakout.description: Buy breakouts above key resistance in confirmed uptrends
trend_following_breakout.entry: Price breaks above resistance with volume confirmation
trend_following_breakout.exit: Trailing stop at 2x ATR below swing high

trend_following_pullback.description: Buy pullbacks to EMA support in uptrends
trend_following_pullback.entry: Price pulls back to EMA20/50 and bounces with bullish candle
trend_following_pullback.exit: Target previous high, stop below pullback low

short_trend_breakdown.description: Short breakdowns below support in confirmed downtrends
short_trend_breakdown.entry: Price breaks below support with increasing volume
short_trend_breakdown.exit: Cover at next support level, stop above breakdown level

mean_reversion_ranging.description: Buy at range support, sell at range resistance
mean_reversion_ranging.entry: Price touches lower Bollinger Band with RSI < 35
mean_reversion_ranging.exit: Target middle or upper BB, stop below range low

volatility_breakout.entry: Bollinger Band squeeze followed by expansion with volume
volatility_breakout.exit: Target 2x ATR move, tight stop at entry

stay_flat.description: Do nothing in dead markets. Patience is a strategy.
